text:
Sales of electric cars have grown rapidly, and the question is whether their advantages outweigh the disadvantages. This essay will discuss both sides before explaining my own view.

On the positive side, electric cars cut local pollution and running costs. They emit nothing from the exhaust, are quiet and cheap to run. A taxi driver who switches to an electric model, for example, may save a large part of his fuel bill, and residents of a busy street breathe cleaner air and hear less noise. Electric motors also need less maintenance than petrol engines, because they have fewer moving parts. Since transport is a major source of greenhouse gases, the shift to electricity, particularly when it comes from renewable sources, can contribute to climate targets. Many governments also offer tax benefits and free parking for electric vehicles.

On the negative side, electric cars face high prices and charging limits. Purchase prices, scarce chargers, battery production and electricity from coal reduce their benefit. A person who lives in a flat with no private parking, for example, may find it hard to charge a car overnight, and long journeys require planning around charging stations. The mining of materials for batteries causes environmental and social damage, and old batteries must be recycled. Nevertheless, prices are falling, networks of chargers are growing and batteries are improving in range and lifespan. The net gain also increases as electricity grids become cleaner.

In conclusion, electric cars have important advantages for air quality and costs, and I believe that they outweigh the disadvantages, provided that governments invest in charging infrastructure and clean electricity.

Giảm ô nhiễm cục bộ và chi phí: không khí thải, êm, rẻ; ví dụ tài xế taxi chuyển xe điện tiết kiệm nhiên liệu, cư dân thở khí sạch; ít bảo dưỡng; giảm khí nhà kính; ưu đãi thuế, đỗ xe.

Giá cao, ít trạm sạc, sản xuất pin, điện từ than; ví dụ người ở căn hộ không chỗ đỗ riêng khó sạc; đường dài lập kế hoạch; khai thác vật liệu; tái chế pin. Nhưng giá giảm, mạng sạc, pin tốt hơn; lưới điện sạch.
Ưu hơn nhược nếu đầu tư trạm sạc và điện sạch.
